findings.pit_membership: Historical CSI300 snapshots are applied forward from their snapshot date; no current-universe backfill is required.
findings.pit_fundamentals: Extended fundamentals are joined backward by available_date and reject available_date before report_date or after prediction date.
findings.pit_industry: Industry classifications are joined by effective date and reject future-effective records.
findings.labels: Existing 5D/20D research labels already use next-open to future-open and maturity dates; V30 adds calendar-aligned 1D/5D/20D labels without overwriting parent datasets.
findings.v6: Retained as incumbent ranking system and not rewritten.
findings.v26_v29: Directional/tail probabilities are converted to centered ranks, so they cannot be exposed as calibrated probabilities.
findings.freeze: Existing immutable locks and negative reports remain untouched; V30 uses a new manifest and output root.
findings.future_shadow: Existing 126-day shadow protocol remains intact and execution_authorized remains false; only its role is changed to long-horizon confirmation for V30.
findings.v29: Frozen run was interrupted by explicit user request before candidate performance output and is not resumed by V30.
